purpose: Static low-poly catalog candidate only; not independent, user, GPU, scene or release approval.

criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Inspect every final exact view and compare to original scope. All three concept panels personally inspected. Keep naked tapering axial hierarchy and paired elongate sporangia, but correct the concept single pair per lateral arm into multiple pairs at ends of repeatedly dichotomized sprays. Reduce tree-like thick trunk/large basal buttresses, make stem slender, replace evenly alternating arms by irregular azimuths. Base minimal and explicitly conjectural, not a copied fossil root system.

Verify A dominant tapering naked main axis with unequal overtopping forks and subordinate repeatedly dichotomized lateral sprays, distributed around the axis. Five fertile lateral sprays carry multiple grouped terminal pairs of elongate, slightly downward-curved fusiform sporangia; two sterile sprays retain narrow naked tips. Whole exterior plant including a minimal conjectural basal anchorage, not a leafy fern, equal-Y Cooksonia, woody tree, cone or flower. Conservative whole-organism P. dawsonii art reconstruction. Fossil axes and terminal pairs support gross architecture; the exact complete basal habit, height, proportions, branch counts and colors are artistic, not measured preserved facts. No invented broad leaves, spores, tissue ultrastructure or environment claim. Upper branch morphology prioritized but whole original scope retained.
Verify the frozen brief, complete deliverables and all explicit constraints.
Parse this exact GLB with the pinned target loader and record bounds, materials and errors.
Render this exact GLB in the target graphics runtime; inspect frames and capture renderer/device and measured work.
Render the intended composed scene including this exact GLB; inspect scale/contact/material consistency and measure scene work.
